headline: Stop asking questions in your hooks.
proof: I've edited 1,000+ Reels. Statements stop the scroll. Questions let people scroll past.
caption:
Most creators lose people in the first 2 seconds because their hook sounds optional.

"Wanna know how?" lets people decide if they care.
"Your first 2 seconds are killing your views" makes them stop.

Question hooks underperform statement hooks about 3 to 1 in everything I've edited. Tease, don't ask.
